images.title: Net of a 4 by 2 by 1 cuboid
images.purpose: Shows a net of a cuboid made of three pairs of equal rectangles, drawn to scale.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. One net in the centre, drawn to scale on no grid, with matching pairs in matching colours and a few edge lengths labelled outside it.
images.exact_structure: Scale: 1 cm drawn as one unit. A horizontal row of 4 walls, all 1 unit tall, from left to right: wall 1 is 4 by 1, wall 2 is 2 by 1, wall 3 is 4 by 1, wall 4 is 2 by 1 (row 12 units long). A 4 by 2 rectangle sits directly above wall 1 and another 4 by 2 rectangle directly below wall 1, sharing wall 1's long edges. Whole net 12 units wide and 5 units tall. Colours by pair: the two 4 by 2 rectangles teal #0072B2, walls 1 and 3 amber #E69F00, walls 2 and 4 green #009E73. Thin dark outlines on all 6 rectangles. Labels: '4 cm' along the top edge of the upper rectangle, '2 cm' along its left edge, '1 cm' along the right end of wall 4, and below the net 'area 28 square cm'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A cuboid net has three pairs of equal rectangles; its area is 2 × (8 + 4 + 2) = 28 square cm.
images.description: Shows a net of a cuboid made of three pairs of equal rectangles, drawn to scale.
images.context: Concept T7.C3; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Edges that meet when folded have equal length: the 2 cm sides of the top meet the 2 cm walls.

image_decisions.why: Drawing the net is the concept; one scaled net with colour coded pairs shows the method at once.
